decisions.reason: As a two-component resin injection unit, it remains close to the firm's plural-component and injection capabilities, and several years of market learning make continued refinement more likely than withdrawal.

This resin injection unit also draws directly on the firm's established fluid-handling and application knowledge, so management would usually keep it while using accumulated field feedback to improve fit and performance.
An automatic airless spray gun sits squarely in the firm's core spray technology domain, giving it strong absorptive capacity to support, adapt and commercialize the product over time.
Because this air-assisted airless spray gun line covers several models in a central competence area, the firm is very likely to retain it as a platform for serving different customer requirements.

The data logger is less central than the mechanical equipment range, but as a complement to coating systems the firm has likely built enough learning and customer-use knowledge to keep it rather than exit immediately.
